annotations.title: Write a job advert and check the pay

description: Job Spotter. Write a job advert and check the pay. For employers: "help me write an advert for a care assistant", "is £12 an hour enough?". Builds a clear advert from the title, duties, must-haves and pay, flags what puts applicants off (missing pay, too many must-haves, slang like "rockstar", age-coded or gendered wording, "native speaker") and compares the pay with current adverts for the role and place. Nothing is posted or stored; posting is free at jobspotter.pages.dev/employers.

about.description: A line or two about the company.

duties.description: What the person will do, one per line or comma separated.

pay_per.description: Pay per: year, hour, day or month.

type.description: Type: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship or per_diem.
